name: agent-guide-unbranded-inert
body: The embedded author-guide content must remain unbranded (no corporate branding and no reference to files under `brand/`), text-only and offline, format-accurate (no drift from the format the code implements; see agent-guide-drift-check), and inert. Each guide is delivered as a kalide-owned full guide `AGENTS_KALIDE.md`, written verbatim by scaffolding, plus an `AGENTS.md` pointer carrying the reference line `Kalide Reference: ./AGENTS_KALIDE.md` (agent-guide-reference); the pointer's permitted modifications are exactly agent-guide-reference's set (creation carrying the embedded pointer content when absent, appending the reference line to an author file without the string, and the `kalide upgrade` replacement of a known released full guide); it is otherwise author-preserving. The library layout permits both as inert non-template root entries (library-guide-layout). Neither file is ever read by the load/validate/render/serve/list code paths, and neither is a template asset nor referenced as one.
